summary_en: Entry as titular requires a qualifying teaching credential, fitness and conduct conditions, and statutory eligibility requirements. The text allows foreign applicants subject to residence and Spanish requirements.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 57 also prints an initial-entry age ceiling of 50 with exceptions. Record it as supplied text, not a verified restriction in force in 2026; a transitory credential exception is also printed.

summary_en: Base-post recruitment uses a competition of credentials and antecedents, with appointments following the merit list.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 59 contains an exception for third-category directors where serving staff show no interest; tertiary hour posts have a separate examination rule and are outside this primary case.

summary_en: Titular staff have conditional stability. Initial titular-interino appointment continues until a fitness examination and an appraisal of at least 6 points are passed.
exceptions_and_limits: The first eligible school year is used for appraisal; appraisal requires at least three months for titular interino under article 130. Provisional and substitute employees do not receive the same stability right.

summary_en: Loss of stability includes specified low-appraisal thresholds, discipline and exhaustion of availability; serious disciplinary sanctions require prior proceedings and defense rights.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 18(b): two appraisals below 6 in five years or one below 4 lead to investigation and a disciplinary-tribunal opinion before cessation. Availability may last five years, with only the first paid under article 22.

summary_en: Most listed leadership and inspection promotions require credentials, antecedents and an examination; other listed posts use credentials and antecedents only.
exceptions_and_limits: Titular promotion differs from temporary assignment of hierarchical functions (article 75). Article 81 sets a maximum two-year interval subject to an approved-candidate exception.

summary_en: General promotion eligibility requires titular status, active service and appraisal conditions, but this supplied statute delegates further post-specific requirements.
exceptions_and_limits: No comparable role-specific service-year schedule is established here; obtain the regulation under article 80(d) before coding a numeric threshold. Do not enter zero.

summary_en: Article 33 specifies seniority increments on the assignment for the post or teaching hours: 50% at 10 years and 120% at 24 years.
exceptions_and_limits: The entire printed schedule must not be treated as current payroll. Article 34 regulates recognized service and adjustment; additional remuneration components are separate.

summary_en: No positive training- or attendance-conditioned additional payment was identified in the supplied remuneration provisions.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 125 provides deductions for unjustified absence and lateness; that is a penalty, not a positive incentive. Later salary agreements or regulations were not supplied in this case.

summary_en: Titular, titular-interino, provisional and substitute staff are appraised annually by their hierarchical superior using a professional record.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 130 defers appraisal during unresolved investigations and excludes service shorter than 30 days (three months for titular interino). This is a prescribed process, not proof of actual practice.

summary_en: Promotion eligibility requires at least 8 points in each of the last two appraised years. Appraisal also enters the classification formula.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 51 multiplies the average appraisal by credentials plus seniority; minimum eligibility and ranking are distinct mechanisms.

summary_en: Teachers can inspect and challenge their professional record and seek revocation of an appraisal with hierarchical appeal to the central classification tribunal.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 129 names the appraisal appeal route. General article 161 sets ten days from notification; article 165 states working-day computation. Verify implementing procedure before practical use.

summary_en: No distinct advanced classroom-teacher ranks meeting the pilot definition were identified in the supplied career ladder.
exceptions_and_limits: The ladder lists base teachers and higher hierarchical roles; specialized-function bonuses and more teaching hours do not alone establish advanced classroom ranks. Search scope: articles 11-16,31-39,69-88 and 171.

summary_en: Teachers have a duty to improve their pedagogical preparation; authorities must encourage and facilitate professional development through centers, scholarships, courses and other measures.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 171 includes in-school training for active teachers. This is not a verified annual training entitlement of a specified number of hours.

summary_en: Additional credentials and qualifying certificates count as valued entry antecedents; specialist titles and certificates retain their validity and points across the career.
exceptions_and_limits: The detailed numerical scale is delegated. Credit is not evidence that the training improves classroom practice.

summary_en: Articles 114-116 list leave causes and permit study/professional-development leave, with duration and conditions delegated to regulation.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 115 is discretionary (may grant). The PDF carries an emergency-law note above article 114; current effect is unresolved. Do not infer paid duration from these articles.

summary_en: Provisional and substitute appointments use classification lists, with a complementary list when qualified candidates are unavailable or decline. Substitutes normally cease when the absent employee returns.
exceptions_and_limits: Provisional service does not itself confer titular status (article 111). The supplied chapter does not specify a universal minimum absence or guaranteed replacement deadline.

summary_en: The supplied text requires appropriate official credentials, fitness, nationality/residence conditions and application to statutory competitions; primary credentials are specified in article 62.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 61 prints an age maximum of 40, with an exception for certain entrants over 40 and under 45 with prior service. Legal currency is unverified; do not treat old restrictions as confirmed current law.

summary_en: Primary recruitment uses credentials and antecedents, with examinations when considered necessary. The primary list includes qualifications, prior service, residence and education-related activities.
exceptions_and_limits: Do not code an examination as universally mandatory. Scoring weights are not supplied; article 61 also prints historical application-seniority provisions.

summary_en: The text establishes conditional job stability tied to statutory conduct, efficiency and physical-capacity requirements.
exceptions_and_limits: No general probation length was identified in the general/primary provisions. Article 78 makes temporary appointments cease on the titular returning; do not extend titular protection unconditionally to substitutes.

summary_en: The text specifies disciplinary dismissal/removal and protects defense rights through prior proceedings for listed sanctions, with an express attendance-related exception.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 56 allows up to 30 days of suspension without prior proceedings for repeated lateness or unjustified absence, with a reasoned written act. Article 21 also sets cessation following exhausted availability.

summary_en: Primary vice-director, director and inspection-secretary promotions use antecedents and examinations; general provisions also require competitive selection for management/inspection.
exceptions_and_limits: Articles 70-72 specify assessed antecedents and written, oral and school-work observation components. Promotions also include location and category changes, which must be coded separately.

summary_en: Primary vice-director requires five years as a teacher; director requires two years as vice-director or seven years in teaching.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 76 additionally requires three years of provincial service for competitions, reduced to two for director/vice-director posts in unfavorable or very unfavorable locations. Other roles have different thresholds.

summary_en: The supplied seniority schedule provides 38% at ten years and 120% at 28 years, calculated on the assignment for the post.
exceptions_and_limits: These are printed statutory percentages, not verified current payroll. Recognized non-simultaneous teaching service is addressed in article 40.

summary_en: No positive additional payment conditional on training or attendance was identified in the supplied remuneration chapter.
exceptions_and_limits: Training support, geographical allowances, differentiated work and disciplinary attendance sanctions are different mechanisms. Later pay agreements and implementing regulations are not in this province packet.

summary_en: Annual appraisal uses objective information in a professional file and a conceptual/numerical scale. The record covers titular, interim and substitute staff.
exceptions_and_limits: The supplied text prescribes appraisal but does not show how it operates or its measurement reliability.

summary_en: General promotion eligibility requires at least Bueno in the last two years; primary promotion antecedents also include effectiveness, responsibility, initiative and attendance.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 27 waives the appraisal threshold after an unfilled competition or for specified single-teacher schools in unfavorable locations. Do not describe seniority as the only promotion criterion.

summary_en: Teachers may inspect and challenge their file; appraisal can be reconsidered and appealed to the classification and discipline board within ten days of notification.
exceptions_and_limits: The PDF does not establish here that these are calendar versus working days; retain the printed wording.

summary_en: No distinct advanced classroom-teacher ranks meeting the pilot definition were identified in the general/primary career provisions.
exceptions_and_limits: The primary ladder has teacher/teacher-secretary, vice-director, director and supervisor. Location/category promotion and seniority pay do not qualify as advanced classroom stages. Review articles 8,25-28,36-49,65-77,81.

summary_en: Teachers must improve their pedagogical capacity, and authorities are to facilitate professional development through courses and study/research scholarships.
exceptions_and_limits: Support provision does not establish a fixed annual entitlement or actual participation.

summary_en: Primary entry and promotion value studies, publications and education-related activities among antecedents.
exceptions_and_limits: The supplied provisions do not provide a course-credit scale; further regulations are needed to compare weights or approved training.

summary_en: Article 6(l) provides one year of paid study leave after at least five years of teaching and every ten years thereafter, subject to regulation; scholarship leave is also recognized.
exceptions_and_limits: No complete general sickness/family leave schedule is supplied in this statute. The implementing regulation, eligibility details and current effect require verification.

summary_en: Primary substitutes meet titular eligibility requirements, are ranked on annual lists, and can retain successive replacements for school continuity. Full vacancy triggers automatic change from substitute to interim.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 80 balances opportunities for more applicants with school continuity; article 78 permits displacement of non-credentialed temporary staff by a specialist-qualified teacher. No primary coverage deadline is specified in these articles.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: The supplied primary statute requires listed teacher credentials and psychophysical conditions; naturalized citizens are subject to a printed ten-year residence requirement.
exceptions_and_limits: Special-subject posts have a separate credential route under article 12. Current enforceability of historical conditions has not been checked.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: Primary recruitment uses credentials and antecedents, a board-issued descending merit list and statutory appointment procedures.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 14(e) lists course credit, education-related work, credential age, prior service and residence; it does not provide the complete numerical scale. Rural-specialist preferences apply on ties under article 15.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: Titular staff have conditional stability; article 16(c) gives rights and duties of an effective appointment from taking possession, subject to executive convalidation.
exceptions_and_limits: No general probation duration is identified. Do not convert convalidation into an assumed probation period.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: Dismissal/removal and major sanctions are regulated with defense rights and prior proceedings. Two consecutive insufficient appraisals can lead to cessation.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 41 lists dismissal grounds; article 37 provides eventual cessation after one paid and one unpaid year of availability following a justified refusal of relocation.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: Article 67 retains the basic leadership/inspection promotion rule: competition of credentials, antecedents and examination, with a rural third-category exception. The complete procedure also requires Law 10237.
exceptions_and_limits: The supplied text marks articles 70, 71 and 73–77 as repealed by article 20 of Law 10237. Article 72 is amended, not repealed: it regulates temporary leadership coverage and expressly refers to article 10 of that law. The full law is still to obtain. Confidence remains medium for completeness, not because article 67 is absent.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: Article 67 retains explicit minimum teaching-service requirements: 5 years for urban third-category director, 8 for vice-director, 10 for second-category director, and 12 for first-category director.
exceptions_and_limits: Inspection requirements also remain printed in article 67, including an amendment to paragraph (e). Law 10237 is needed to complete the procedure; the missing law does not erase these visible thresholds. Current legal force is still unverified.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: The remuneration article is marked repealed; this packet does not establish a usable primary seniority percentage schedule.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 81 is repealed by Law 6030; the opening notes point to Decree 1001/14 for remuneration. Neither full instrument is supplied. Do not code no seniority pay.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: Economy and Public Management Ministry Resolution 7/2024 creates a monthly remunerative additional of 10% of usual remunerative components, conditional on mandatory training participation (and passing where required) and monthly attendance limits.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 3: no more than 3 justified absences per month, or 5% of monthly obligations for hourly teachers; specified protected leave is excluded. No more than 1 unjustified absence. Passing training is required only if stipulated. Article 4 and Annex I govern proportional payment and excluded situations. Created effective January 2024, with conditions from the following month. This is not assessed teaching-performance pay; both Córdoba cases refer to the same instrument.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: Appraisal is annual and also occurs on transfer or promotion, using objective professional-record entries and a conceptual/numerical scale.
exceptions_and_limits: School directors are appraised by inspectors under article 61. Titular, interim and substitute records are covered by article 58.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: Professional-record appraisal is used in the career system, but a comparable promotion-eligibility threshold cannot be resolved from this packet.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 59 calls for appraisal on promotion, but old article 70 is repealed and the operative competition framework refers to Law 10237. Do not infer that the absence of a visible Bueno threshold means appraisal is irrelevant.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: Teachers can inspect their professional notebook and seek reconsideration and appeal of appraisal within ten days; the classification board handles the appeal.
exceptions_and_limits: The period is printed without a calendar/working-day specification in article 59; check the applicable procedural rules.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: No formal advanced classroom-teacher stages meeting the codebook definition were identified in the primary ladder and promotion provisions.
exceptions_and_limits: A one-teacher-school director or promotion to school leadership is not coded as an advanced classroom-teacher rank. External and later legislation may add roles; search scope: articles 6-10,58-79 plus supplied supplements.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: Teachers must develop their culture and pedagogical capacity; authorities are to support seminars, courses and scholarships through paid-leave arrangements and subsidies.
exceptions_and_limits: The source does not set a quantified annual training entitlement.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: Officially recognized and supervised training/updating courses are credited in recruitment antecedents according to importance and duration.
exceptions_and_limits: Detailed scoring is delegated. The separate 2024 payment condition is coded under PR 04 and is not merged with career points.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: The statute refers leave to a separate legal regime based on Law 4356. The supplied 2024 union guide summarizes leave and distinguishes titular/interim from substitutes.
exceptions_and_limits: The guide is secondary guidance, not the full law. It summarizes 60 short-treatment days and up to 730 long-treatment days for titular/interim staff, and 30 paid illness days for substitutes, with qualifications. These are not independently verified current entitlements.

education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
summary_en: Annual substitute lists use descending merit order. The text calls for possession on the first leave day and obligatory replacement for leave over eight days, with immediate coverage for single-teacher closure risk.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 33 permits ad-honorem replacement for shorter leave; reconcile with article 30, rather than coding all absences as automatically covered. Article 27 as amended in 2022 permits specified cross-year continuity.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: The secondary/general statute admits nationals and foreign teachers with Spanish knowledge; appropriate teaching, habilitating or supplementary credentials and other eligibility conditions are required.
exceptions_and_limits: Unlike the primary wording, this text explicitly permits foreigners. Habilitating/supplementary credentials are limited by article 12 as amended by Law 10729.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: Ordinary non-management posts use credentials and antecedents, with examination added only on tied scores; special programmes can use additional suitability procedures.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 17 bis delegates programme-specific methods to regulation. Do not transfer the universal examination rule for higher education in article 150 to secondary recruitment.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: The statute provides conditional stability; its amended titular definition covers qualified teachers appointed by competition or confirmed under the statute.
exceptions_and_limits: Law 10729 permits a specific regularization for serving coordinators, ProA and PIT staff; it is not a universal automatic regularization of all interim teachers. No general probation length is specified here.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: Major sanctions require prior proceedings and defense rights. Two consecutive insufficient appraisals can lead to cessation, subject to regulatory safeguards.
exceptions_and_limits: Protected stability also depends on duties and physical capacity; redundancy/availability is separately addressed in articles 140-142.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: Leadership and inspection promotions require credentials, antecedents and examination; other ladder promotions use examinations on tied scores.
exceptions_and_limits: The packet identifies Law 10237 as the governing competition framework. Full rules for scheduling, jury composition and exceptions remain incomplete without that law and regulations.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: For secondary posts, the printed requirements are six teaching years for vice-director (three in the level/modality), eight for director (four in level/modality), and ten for inspector (five in level/modality plus management status).
exceptions_and_limits: These clauses incorporate Law 10237 amendments but the full competition law is not supplied. Higher-education thresholds in article 147 are different and excluded from this case.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: The remuneration chapter is marked repealed, so a seniority percentage schedule cannot be recovered from this packet.
exceptions_and_limits: The preface refers remuneration to Decree 1001/14. The presence of seniority points in article 7(j) is a ranking rule, not a pay schedule.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: Economy and Public Management Ministry Resolution 7/2024 creates a monthly remunerative additional of 10% of usual remunerative components, conditional on mandatory training participation (and passing where required) and monthly attendance limits.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 3: no more than 3 justified absences per month, or 5% of monthly obligations for hourly teachers; specified protected leave is excluded. No more than 1 unjustified absence. Passing training is required only if stipulated. Article 4 and Annex I govern proportional payment and excluded situations. Created effective January 2024, with conditions from the following month. This is not assessed teaching-performance pay; both Córdoba cases refer to the same instrument.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: Annual appraisal uses a conceptual/numerical scale and professional file; directors and their management teams appraise staff, supplemented by inspection observations.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 45 separately covers appraisal after more than 30 consecutive days for temporary staff who are not titular in the establishment.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: Promotion eligibility includes at least Bueno in the last two years plus active-service status and other vacancy requirements.
exceptions_and_limits: This is an eligibility threshold, not an estimated weight or proof of effective differentiation in practice.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: Teachers may inspect and challenge the file, request reconsideration from the appraiser and appeal to the immediate hierarchical authority with a board report.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 93 specifies ten days for file-content objections; do not automatically use that as the distinct appraisal-appeal deadline under article 95.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: No formal advanced classroom-teacher ranks meeting the pilot definition were identified in the secondary ladder.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 17 bis names course coordinators and programme posts, but does not establish graded classroom-teacher stages or a merit ladder. More hours, location/category changes and management promotions are separate mechanisms. Search scope: articles 9,17 bis,24-28,50-67 plus Law 10729.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: Teachers must update scientific, pedagogical and didactic knowledge; authorities promote courses, scholarships, professional meetings, libraries and educational literature.
exceptions_and_limits: The supplied text does not quantify annual access or verify actual availability.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: Satisfactorily completed courses meeting the regulatory standards receive antecedent points.
exceptions_and_limits: The detailed requirements and numerical scale are delegated, with a reference to Decree 257/19. Do not infer points for every course.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: The statute recognizes paid study leave of one year every ten teaching years, subject to regulation, and scholarship leave; the supplied union guide summarizes the external general leave framework.
exceptions_and_limits: The study right is in article 7(m); the 2024 guide is not a legal instrument and distinguishes employment statuses. Full Law 4356 and amendments are needed before coding complete sickness/family entitlements.

education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
summary_en: Temporary coverage first seeks staff already at the establishment, ranked by board points, then the external merit lists; continuity spans leave extensions and repeated replacement in the same year.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 43 permits proposals outside lists if no applicants exist. Article 48 prints an end-February cessation for certain interim appointments and cessation of substitutes when titular returns; its annotation references a 2005 extension that needs checking.

summary_en: Entry requires a qualifying credential, psychophysical fitness and statutory nationality or residence/Spanish conditions.
exceptions_and_limits: Foreign applicants and alternative credentials have specific conditions; do not transfer initial-education age rules into this primary case.

summary_en: Primary entry uses a credentials and antecedents competition, complemented by examinations only in specifically determined cases.
exceptions_and_limits: An examination is not established as universal for ordinary primary recruitment.

summary_en: Titular teachers have stability conditional on statutory duties. Structural displacement is handled through availability and reassignment provisions.
exceptions_and_limits: Temporary appointments are distinct. Availability has different paid/unpaid durations depending on whether a suitable post is offered.

summary_en: The supplied versions differ on the sequence following deficient appraisals. The 2022 regulation provides improvement training before possible proceedings; the annex labeled 2026 describes an administrative cessation route with notice and response.
exceptions_and_limits: Unresolved version conflict: obtain the adopting instrument for the supplied 2026 annex before determining the applicable procedure. Serious disciplinary sanctions have separate safeguards.

summary_en: Promotion requires ministry courses followed by an opposition examination. The annex labeled 2026 changes course assessment from a numeric component to pass/fail admission.
exceptions_and_limits: The statute and its 2022 regulation should be distinguished from the unverified-adoption 2026 annex. Do not pool the two course-scoring systems.

summary_en: General promotion eligibility requires two years as titular in the immediately preceding post or three in the post before it, subject to exceptions.
exceptions_and_limits: Insufficient eligible candidates can trigger exceptions. These are post-specific eligibility rules, not a universal total-career threshold.

summary_en: The printed seniority schedule rises from 30% after one year to 120% after 22 years, with intermediate steps.
exceptions_and_limits: Describes the supplied statutory schedule, not verified current take-home pay or purchasing power. Non-simultaneous recognized service counts under separate rules.

summary_en: Article 78 authorizes the ministry to grant salary incentives for designated training.
exceptions_and_limits: Authorization is not proof that a payment scheme was implemented. No amount or operative scheme is specified here; the supplied 2026 annex leaves article 78 unregulated.

summary_en: Annual conceptual and numeric appraisal draws on the professional record and considers teacher conditions and aptitudes.
exceptions_and_limits: Keep annual appraisal distinct from a promotion examination and from observed teaching quality.

summary_en: Promotion requires at least Muy Bueno in the last two years. Appraisal also contributes points to antecedent ranking for course admission.
exceptions_and_limits: Threshold and ranking points are separate mechanisms; neither alone demonstrates performance-based salary.

summary_en: Teachers may inspect and contest their professional record, and annual appraisal is notified with appeal rights.
exceptions_and_limits: Promotion examinations have narrower review rules; do not extend general appraisal appeals to final examination decisions.

summary_en: The primary ladder explicitly includes Maestro Especialista as an alternative stage after Maestro de Grado, separate from the school-trajectory coordinator route.
exceptions_and_limits: This establishes a formal classroom career stage in the supplied text. It does not establish actual staffing, uptake, or effectiveness.

summary_en: Teachers have a duty to keep their preparation current and a right to free, comprehensive professional development throughout their career.
exceptions_and_limits: A statutory right does not establish actual availability or participation.

summary_en: Training courses can receive classification points; the annex labeled 2026 specifies different rates by course relevance/provider and sets caps and validity limits.
exceptions_and_limits: 2026 scoring details are conditional on verifying adoption. Course points are not the same as salary increments; mandatory and optional training have different functions.

summary_en: The statute specifies leave categories and a paid study-leave route of up to one year every seven years for eligible titular staff.
exceptions_and_limits: Study leave includes appraisal, discipline, reporting and quota conditions; entitlement should not be generalized to every temporary appointment.

summary_en: Temporary vacancies and replacements use ranked public allocation with school and employment-status priorities. Continued appointments and conversion to interim status have separate conditions.
exceptions_and_limits: The supplied 2026 annex details allocation priorities and exceptions. Verify its adopting act before treating those detailed procedures as applicable current law.

education_scope: Primary plus general provisions; appended leadership and implementing instruments distinguished
summary_en: The supplied text requires an appropriate teaching credential, physical capacity and conduct conditions, Argentine nationality under the stated categories, and real domicile in the school department. The primary chapter also prints an entry-age limit.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 74 prints a maximum entry age of 40, with a limited route for applicants over 40 and under 45 who have at least one year of teaching service. These are supplied historical restrictions, not verified present-day eligibility. Articles 14–16 allow exceptional credential/idoneity routes; article 18 permits an outside-department appointment when no eligible local teacher is available. Decree 455/2002 adds domicile-evidence rules.

education_scope: Primary plus general provisions; appended leadership and implementing instruments distinguished
summary_en: Primary entry normally uses a competition of credentials and antecedents, with opposition tests in the expressly specified cases. Appointments follow departmental merit lists.
exceptions_and_limits: Do not code a universal entry examination: article 76 specifically requires one for direct entry to a third-category directorship. Decree-Law 3267 separately provides an exceptional no-competition titularization route for interim teachers in inhospitable-zone schools (see AS03).

education_scope: Primary plus general provisions; appended leadership and implementing instruments distinguished
summary_en: Titular stability is conditional on conduct, professional/psychophysical capacity and the stated domicile rule. The bundle also contains an exceptional route from interim to titular appointment in inhospitable-zone schools after one uninterrupted school year and an on-site assessment.
exceptions_and_limits: The zone route in Decree-Law 3267 is conditional, not automatic tenure for every interim teacher. Law 5103 articles 3–4 separately makes leadership titular appointments time-limited: four years, with one evaluation-dependent renewal. The original statute retains a historical transitory suspension clause (article 173); its present effect is not resolved here. The 2000 disciplinary regulation explicitly recognizes titular stability.

education_scope: Primary plus general provisions; appended leadership and implementing instruments distinguished
summary_en: The supplied statute and disciplinary regulation provide dismissal/exoneration sanctions and procedures protecting the right of defence. Structural displacement has separate paid-availability and reassignment rules; justified refusal can lead to cessation after the stated availability periods.
exceptions_and_limits: Keep disciplinary removal, structural cessation and expiry of a Law 5103 leadership term separate. Decree 413/2000 permits full or abbreviated proceedings; its later appended special abandonment procedure routes titular cases onward to those proceedings. Do not infer a simple low-appraisal automatic-dismissal rule from the general efficacy condition.

education_scope: Primary plus general provisions; appended leadership and implementing instruments distinguished
summary_en: Appended Law 5103 establishes leadership/supervision competitions combining professional antecedents, an opposition examination and a personal interview based on an institutional leadership or supervision project. Appointments last four years and may be renewed once following an evaluation of project objectives.
exceptions_and_limits: Law 5103 article 10 suspends conflicting promotion provisions of Law 3122. Do not present the older articles 82–92 as a complete settled governing framework. Competition-specific bases and implementing regulation are not supplied. This descriptive code captures the examination plus incomplete supporting rules; the interview, project and term are retained explicitly in the finding.

education_scope: Primary plus general provisions; appended leadership and implementing instruments distinguished
summary_en: Law 5103 article 2(b) requires the experience, antecedents and credential conditions specified in the competition bases. The bundle does not supply those bases, so a settled numeric leadership-experience threshold cannot be assigned.
exceptions_and_limits: Historical article 83 prints ten years as classroom teacher/teacher-secretary, or alternative director-service routes; articles 84–89 print other role-specific thresholds. Retain them as historical context because Law 5103 article 10 suspends conflicting promotion provisions. Do not encode ten years as an unqualified present requirement.

education_scope: Primary plus general provisions; appended leadership and implementing instruments distinguished
summary_en: The printed seniority schedule ranges from 10% after one year to 120% after 24 years. Article 46 sets the calculation base as the allocation for the post held; certified non-simultaneous teaching service is recognized under article 50.
exceptions_and_limits: Intermediate steps are 15% at two years, 30% at five, 40% at seven, 50% at ten, 60% at twelve, 70% at fifteen, 80% at seventeen, 100% at twenty and 110% at twenty-two. This is the supplied schedule, not verified current earnings. Article 47 and amended article 49 print different adjustment-timing language; do not infer a payroll implementation calendar.

education_scope: Primary plus general provisions; appended leadership and implementing instruments distinguished
summary_en: No additional payment explicitly conditional on completing training or meeting an attendance threshold was identified in the supplied remuneration chapters and appended instruments.
exceptions_and_limits: Search scope: the full 144-page bundle, with detailed review of general remuneration articles 46–59, primary remuneration article 101, training Decree817/88 and disciplinary rules. Training points, paid study leave, absence sanctions, geography allowances and longer-day allowances do not establish this narrowly defined pay incentive. Not identified is not proof of absence in other instruments.

education_scope: Primary plus general provisions; appended leadership and implementing instruments distinguished
summary_en: The superior prepares an annual appraisal from objective information in the professional record, using a conceptual scale with corresponding numeric values. Article 23 covers titular, interim and substitute teachers.
exceptions_and_limits: A prescribed annual appraisal does not demonstrate implementation, reliability or measured student-learning effects. Short-term primary substitutes/interims also have a separate service-appraisal provision in article 96.

education_scope: Primary plus general provisions; appended leadership and implementing instruments distinguished
summary_en: Older articles 28(c) and 91(b) print a Muy Bueno appraisal requirement for promotion. Because appended Law 5103 suspends conflicting promotion rules and delegates eligibility details to competition bases, that threshold cannot be treated as settled from this bundle alone. Law 5103 explicitly links a leadership-term renewal to evaluation of project objectives.
exceptions_and_limits: Keep annual teacher appraisal, selection criteria and the separate leadership-renewal evaluation distinct. The latter is an explicit mechanism, but does not resolve the missing selection threshold or its scoring. Obtain competition bases and implementing rules before recoding the promotion-appraisal requirement.

education_scope: Primary plus general provisions; appended leadership and implementing instruments distinguished
summary_en: Teachers may inspect, challenge and request completion of their professional record and retain an authenticated duplicate. Annual appraisal can be challenged by reconsideration with subsidiary appeal to the classification board within ten days of notification.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 24 says ten days without specifying working days in that clause; do not borrow the disciplinary working-day deadline. Leadership competition results have a distinct administrative-review route in Law 5103 article 7.

education_scope: Primary plus general provisions; appended leadership and implementing instruments distinguished
summary_en: No distinct higher professional classroom-teacher grade was identified in the primary ladders, remuneration table and supplied career supplements.
exceptions_and_limits: Article 79 groups Maestro with teacher-secretary and some director posts, but does not establish an advanced classroom grade. Article 80 Maestro Especial denotes a subject-specialist entry role, not an advanced grade after ordinary classroom teaching. summary_en: Temporary coverage uses the statutory applicant/antecedent process with a five-day appointment rule and titular-return/year-end cessation exceptions.
Provincial Law 631 sets credential, nationality/Spanish, psychophysical and district-residence conditions, plus a printed age 40/service-offset rule.
exceptions_and_limits: Law 631 expressly covers Initial/EGB 1–2/Special/Adults; do not substitute the supplied national reference or automatically extend this case to secondary.

summary_en: Entry under Law 631 uses credentials/antecedents competitions with listed merit factors.
Stability is conditional on duties, with disciplinary cessation governed by proceedings.
The provincial framework distinguishes disciplinary proceedings, removal authority and structural-availability routes.
exceptions_and_limits: Availability duration differs when the teacher rejects a destination versus when no comparable post is available.

summary_en: Direction/supervision competitions combine titles, antecedents and opposition, with published ranking and vacancy choice.

Vice-director normally requires two years as titular secretary, with an eight-year classroom fallback; director requires three titular vice-director years or five titular secretary years, with a 12-year classroom fallback.
exceptions_and_limits: These are alternative conditional routes, not one universal teaching-years threshold.

summary_en: The provincial schedule ranges from 10% at one year to 135% at 25 years, with 130% at 24 years.
exceptions_and_limits: Preserve this provincial scale rather than replacing it with the national 10%–120% schedule.

summary_en: No training/attendance-conditioned additional pay was identified in the reviewed provincial salary and training provisions.
exceptions_and_limits: The 15% special/adult-service supplement is linked to function/hours, not attendance or training; national references do not establish a local cash incentive. Not identified in the reviewed supplied sections is not proof of absence in other instruments.

summary_en: Annual appraisal is paired with continuing monitoring and at least quarterly written records.
Leadership selection requires Muy Bueno in the last two provincial-school years and values the last concept among antecedents.
exceptions_and_limits: General deserted-competition exceptions are separate.

summary_en: Record inspection/challenge and appraisal reconsideration with subsidiary appeal are prescribed within ten days.
No distinct advanced classroom-teacher grade was identified in the provincial primary ladder.
exceptions_and_limits: Reviewed ladder, training, promotion and remuneration; auxiliary secretary, specialized/support jobs and management do not alone qualify. Not identified in the reviewed supplied sections is not proof of absence in other instruments.

summary_en: Permanent development is both a teacher duty and a prescribed provincial service.
Studies, titles, publications and cultural/pedagogical antecedents enter career assessment.

The statute recognizes study/other leave and points to a transitional regime; supplied later laws add gender-violence and family-care leave, while Law 911 supersedes the older Law 728 family-leave text.
exceptions_and_limits: The full 2014 leave decree is an image-only source requiring further transcription/review; do not infer a complete study-leave day count from it. Later family-leave provisions are recorded as supplements, not substitutes for the full regime.

summary_en: Temporary coverage follows published merit lists and ends on return of the replaced person or titular appointment under the provincial rules.
The supplied statute requires nationality/Spanish, capacity/conduct and credentials; it prints a 35-year ceiling with a recognized-service offset exception.
exceptions_and_limits: Old age restrictions are not verified current eligibility. The 2024 Law 9765 scan updates classification-board provisions and is distinguished from these eligibility clauses.

summary_en: Entry uses antecedents with opposition when considered necessary.
exceptions_and_limits: Extraction order in article 14 is visibly disrupted; preserve the source and verify the rendered clause before numerical summaries.

summary_en: Stability is conditional on conduct, efficiency and capacity; titular, interim and substitute appointment categories are distinguished.
Serious sanctions generally require proceedings and defence, with express exceptions for specified cases including abandonment.
exceptions_and_limits: Do not state a universal prior-sumario rule when the supplied clauses provide exceptions.

summary_en: Category advancement uses antecedent competition; hierarchical advancement adds opposition.
exceptions_and_limits: The two types of movement must remain separate.

summary_en: Director first-call eligibility requires ten classroom years including five provincial years; the second call reduces these to eight/four. Supervisor requirements also differ by call.
exceptions_and_limits: For supervisor: first call 15 relevant years and last 3 titular in the preceding post; second call 12 and last 2. Extraction artifacts require visual confirmation before a numeric comparison.

summary_en: The supplied seniority schedule runs from 10% at one year to 120% at 24+ years.
No training/attendance-conditioned additional pay was identified in the reviewed statutory remuneration/development provisions.
exceptions_and_limits: Reviewed salary, career and development chapters; this is not a search of all later provincial payroll instruments. Not identified in the reviewed supplied sections is not proof of absence in other instruments.

summary_en: Annual conceptual/numeric appraisal is based on the professional record.
First-call promotion requires Muy Bueno in the last three years; second-call eligibility permits Bueno, with different attendance thresholds.
exceptions_and_limits: Professional concept also enters antecedent valuation. The 90%/85% attendance conditions are selection requirements, not a separate salary incentive.

summary_en: Teachers may inspect/challenge the record and seek reconsideration with subsidiary appeal within five working days.
exceptions_and_limits: The 2024 board-resolution reconsideration/appeal provision is additional context, not proof that its deadlines replace the annual appraisal-specific five-working-day rule.

summary_en: No advanced classroom-teacher rank was identified in the supplied primary ladder.
exceptions_and_limits: Reviewed ladder, pay nomenclator and promotion provisions; director/supervisor and special-subject posts are distinct. Not identified in the reviewed supplied sections is not proof of absence in other instruments.

summary_en: The statute provides a teacher-development duty and annual institutional support through courses and scholarships.

Relevant studies, publications and professional/cultural antecedents enter career valuation. The 2024 amendment explicitly directs boards to register accredited training courses and weight them according to the applicable grid.
exceptions_and_limits: A complete numerical grid is not established by these clauses alone.

summary_en: Statutory scholarship/development-leave rights are supplemented by a 2023 ministry guide referring to Decree 505/5.
exceptions_and_limits: The guide is guidance, not the complete primary leave legislation; no unverified day count is assigned.

summary_en: Temporary teachers must meet the required conditions, with same-class continuity and distinct interim/substitute cessation rules. The 2024 board amendment expressly retains annual interim/substitute lists.
exceptions_and_limits: Current board composition is affected by the supplied 2024 amendment; do not assume every earlier organizational clause is unchanged.
